prompt: Set up this fresh checkout using the documented commands and run the fast check. Do not change application behavior. Report the commands and their outcomes.

Add a Note CRUD resource using this repository's supported generator and workflow. Its routes must be /v1/notes and /v1/notes/{id}, exposed in OpenAPI and wired into the running API. Keep reads public. Writes require the notes:write scope; valid tokens without it must receive 403. Use the normal name field, pagination, validation, and response conventions. Include tests.

Add an optional integer priority input field to widgets. Its valid range is 1 through 5; omitting it on POST or PUT uses 3. Explicit null is invalid; only omission uses the default. Persist it through a new migration, include it in all widget responses including lists, and support changing it through PUT. Existing records must receive priority 3 without losing their other data. Reject out-of-range or null create and update inputs with 400 without changing stored data. Update OpenAPI, SQL, and tests.

Add GET /v1/widgets/count to the contract and running API. Return JSON {"count": N} with the current widget count. Require a valid bearer token and the widgets:read scope. Return 401 without a token and 403 for a valid token without permission. Enforce permission in the service before accessing persistence. Preserve the existing widget routes and add tests.

A regression lets callers without widgets:write update widgets. Find and fix it, preserve all existing checks, and add a regression test. The HTTP API must return 403 for a valid token without the write permission and must leave the stored widget unchanged.

This checkout already has a generated Note resource. Add a Label CRUD resource at /v1/labels using the supported workflow. Reads are public; writes require labels:write. Preserve the Note resource and its notes:write policy. Both resources must work in the same running API, appear in OpenAPI, and use normal pagination and validation. Add tests.
